_comment: Site-wide pop-up shown when someone opens the site. active:true shows it, false hides it. Change 'id' whenever you post a NEW message so people who dismissed the last one see it. mode: 'once' = one time per visitor; 'acknowledge' = returns every visit until they click 'Don't show again'; 'untilDate' = shows until 'endDate' (YYYY-MM-DD) passes, then comes down on its own. eyebrow/linkUrl/linkLabel are optional; leave linkUrl empty for no button. endDate is only used by the 'untilDate' mode.
title: Welcome to the New Super Essex Site
body: Browse every school's schedule, follow standings, and watch SEC Vision — all season long.
